_why: OD-52. A rule that no build item implements is allowed — the deploy cadence, the honest uncertainties, the language-model constraint are rules about how we WORK, not code. What is not allowed is silence. D19 fails on any rule id that is neither claimed by a card nor listed here with a reason.

unclaimed.R-244: 2.7 — Admin data editing (spec §9, OD-102..OD-121) is not built yet (release-gate item 36, docs/design/pull-model-completion-state.md) — no build card owns it. Declared unclaimed until a card is created for it, per OD-52. Unrelated to #1106; added only so apply-rule-ownership.mjs can run to completion after spec §9 landed (#1107) without a matching card.
